context: A married couple plans a regional autumn vacation
purpose: Teach: シャッター/ユース/ヨルダン/平野/キット/庵/小倉/愛媛

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 今年の秋は愛媛に行ってみないか。みかん畑も紅葉も綺麗らしいぞ。
lines.en: Want to go to Ehime this autumn? I hear the mikan groves and the autumn leaves are beautiful.
lines.style: Warm relaxed husband floating a vacation idea casually

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いいわね。でも私、ずっと松山の道後温泉に泊まりたかったの。古い庵みたいな宿があるって聞いたわ。
lines.en: Sounds lovely. But I've wanted to stay at Dogo Onsen in Matsuyama for ages. I heard there's an inn like an old hermitage.
lines.style: Soft enthusiastic wife sharing a long-held travel wish

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: じゃあそこを拠点にしよう。途中で小倉にも一泊して、駅前で名物のあんこも味わいたいな。
lines.en: Then let's use it as our base. Let's also stop one night in Kokura and enjoy the famous bean paste near the station.
lines.style: Cheerful husband sketching out a flexible travel route

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 賛成。瀬戸内の平野を見下ろす展望台もあるみたい。あなたカメラ持って行ってシャッター切りまくるんでしょ。
lines.en: Agreed. There's apparently a viewpoint overlooking the Setouchi plain. You'll bring your camera and click the shutter nonstop, won't you?
lines.style: Playful teasing wife anticipating her husband's hobby

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ばれてるな。新しいレンズのキットを買ったばかりだから、試したくてたまらないんだ。
lines.en: You've got me figured out. I just bought a new lens kit and I'm dying to try it.
lines.style: Sheepish honest husband admitting his hobbyist excitement

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ。宿代を抑えたいなら、若い頃みたいにユースホステルに泊まる手もあるけど?
lines.en: Hehe. If you want to save on lodging, we could stay at a youth hostel like in our younger days, hmm?
lines.style: Mischievous wife nostalgically poking fun at frugality

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 今さら勘弁してくれよ。新婚旅行でヨルダン回った時の安宿、覚えてるか?あれが体力の限界だ。
lines.en: Spare me at this age. Remember those cheap inns when we traveled around Jordan on our honeymoon? That was my physical limit.
lines.style: Mock-pleading husband recalling shared travel memories fondly

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 覚えてるわよ。じゃあ今回はちゃんとした旅館で、ゆっくり余韻を味わいましょ。
lines.en: Of course I remember. So this time let's stay at a proper ryokan and savor the experience slowly.
lines.style: Affectionate wife settling the plan with gentle finality
